mode: offline recorded-message replay; no network or model calls
amount_rule: price-like sources, customer numbers, first occurrence, three rounds
first_occurrence_scope: No earlier assistant message contains this currency-marked amount (H).
limitations: Triggers mean uncheckable by this bounded rule, not proven arithmetic errors. Official outcomes remain frozen; this replay does not measure v3 success rates.
